su: number of grid points of upflows
sd: number of grid points of downflows
etm: mean internal energy density <rho*e> (R2D2plus only, vl_et.dac; None for Fortran runs)
wdm: mean work done by magnetic pressure
sermsu: rms entropy / unit mass of upflows
enrmsu: rms internal energy / unit mass of upflows
sermsd: rms entropy / unit mass of downflows
enrmsd: rms internal energy / unit mass of downflows
ro_xy: xy slice of density at kc
vx_xy: xy slice of vx at kc
vy_xy: xy slice of vy at kc
vz_xy: xy slice of vz at kc
bx_xy: xy slice of bx at kc
by_xy: xy slice of by at kc
bz_xy: xy slice of bz at kc
se_xy: xy slice of entropy at kc
pr_xy: xy slice of pressure at kc
te_xy: xy slice of temperature at kc
tu_xy: xy slice of optical depth at kc
en_xy: xy slice of internal energy at kc
op_xy: xy slice of opacity at kc
bxcxco: correlation of bx and current cx = (curl B)_x (no 1/4pi) (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
bxcyco: correlation of bx and current cy = (curl B)_y (no 1/4pi) (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
bxczco: correlation of bx and current cz = (curl B)_z (no 1/4pi) (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
bycxco: correlation of by and current cx = (curl B)_x (no 1/4pi) (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
bycyco: correlation of by and current cy = (curl B)_y (no 1/4pi) (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
byczco: correlation of by and current cz = (curl B)_z (no 1/4pi) (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
bzcxco: correlation of bz and current cx = (curl B)_x (no 1/4pi) (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
bzcyco: correlation of bz and current cy = (curl B)_y (no 1/4pi) (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
bzczco: correlation of bz and current cz = (curl B)_z (no 1/4pi) (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
qrk: heating rate <rho T ds>/dt of the RK step minus radiation (advection, compression, background heating, rk conduction) [erg cm^-3 s^-1] (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
qrte: radiative heating rate used by RK times rho T [erg cm^-3 s^-1] (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
qart: heating rate by artificial diffusion (net, including transport) [erg cm^-3 s^-1] (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
qcond: heating rate by split thermal conduction [erg cm^-3 s^-1] (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
qthin: optically thin radiative loss (heating rate) [erg cm^-3 s^-1] (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
qoth: heating rate by other split operators (flux correction, conservation fix, damping); qrk+qrte+qart+qcond+qthin+qoth = <rho T ds>/dt (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
keart: change rate of kinetic energy by artificial diffusion [erg cm^-3 s^-1] (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
meart: change rate of magnetic energy by artificial diffusion [erg cm^-3 s^-1] (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
ro_xz: xz slice of density at jc
vx_xz: xz slice of vx at jc
vy_xz: xz slice of vy at jc
vz_xz: xz slice of vz at jc
bx_xz: xz slice of bx at jc
by_xz: xz slice of by at jc
bz_xz: xz slice of bz at jc
se_xz: xz slice of entropy at jc
pr_xz: xz slice of pressure at jc
te_xz: xz slice of temperature at jc
tu_xz: xz slice of optical depth at jc
en_xz: xz slice of internal energy at jc
op_xz: xz slice of opacity at jc
fc: vertical conductive flux [erg cm^-2 s^-1] (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
fvxm: SH expansion of vx with m = 0
fvym: SH expansion of vy with m = 0
fvzm: SH expansion of vz with m = 0
fbxm: SH expansion of bx with m = 0
fbym: SH expansion of by with m = 0
fbzm: SH expansion of bz with m = 0
fsem: SH expansion of entropy with m = 0
hist_te: area fraction per log10 T bin at each height, (ix, 100), bins hist_logte_edges (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
hist_ro: area fraction per log10(rho/rho0) bin at each height, (ix, 80), bins hist_logro_edges (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
em_x: emission measure per log10 T bin [cm^-5] along vertical lines of sight, (jx, kx, 60), bins dem_logte_edges (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
em_y: emission measure per log10 T bin [cm^-5] along y lines of sight, (ix, kx, 60) (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
em_z: emission measure per log10 T bin [cm^-5] along z lines of sight, (ix, jx, 60) (R2D2plus vl_layout 2 only, DEC-671)
